name: fpr_classic_balloon_compat
display_name: Classic balloon still tracks memory size changes with FPR off
description: Non-regression contract: with the feature off, QEMU balloon (setmem equivalent) still tracks host-initiated resizes in both directions (directional available-memory deltas above 3/4 of the resize amount). Resize targets are derived from the configured guest RAM (the QMP balloon semantics): shrink to 3/4, grow back to the full size. Directional assertions (delta > 3/4 of the resize amount) instead of absolute values - the reclaimed amount depends on guest state.

test_steps.desc: Make sure FPR is off (classic balloon only)
test_steps.guest_run: $k='HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\BALLOON\Parameters'; if (-not (Test-Path $k)) { New-Item $k -Force | Out-Null }; Set-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name EnableFpr -Value 0 -Type DWord; Write-Output 'PASS: EnableFpr=0 set'

test_steps.desc: Restart balloon device without the feature
Derive the full-size balloon target from the configured guest RAM
Derive the shrink target (3/4 of the full size)
Shrink the guest to 3/4 of its size via QMP balloon
Grow the guest back to its full size via QMP balloon
Probe available memory after growing back
Verify the classic balloon tracked both directions
test_steps.guest_run: $deltaReq = [math]::Round(([uint64]@full_bytes@ - [uint64]@shrink_bytes@) * 3 / 4 / 1MB); if ((@avail_before@ - @avail_mid@) -gt $deltaReq -and (@avail_after@ - @avail_mid@) -gt $deltaReq) { Write-Output 'PASS: classic balloon tracks setmem (before @avail_before@ MB, mid @avail_mid@ MB, after @avail_after@ MB)' } else { Write-Output "FAIL: classic balloon did not track: before @avail_before@ MB, mid @avail_mid@ MB, after @avail_after@ MB, required delta $deltaReq MB"; exit 1 }

cleanup.desc: Derive the full-size balloon target for the best-effort restore below
Best-effort restore of the full-size balloon target (failures do not change the result)
